scope: M1 policy, exact-source readers and tests only. No plugin installation, host trust, sprint or financial/proof acceptance.
reviewerIdentityNote: Fresh independent task; no backend serving identity inferred.

verification.reviewProbes: Executed retained review-probes.py: 2/33 pass, exit 1; the two passing cases are pure policy controls. Remaining cases are denials not enforced, a wrong-type exception and worktree/history defects.
verification.fixtureLimitation: Synthetic positive fixture is not production authority. Negative mutations show contradictions accepted under the author fixture contract; genuine historical campaign reuse separately demonstrates actual adapter ownership failure. Corrections need a supported real-record positive case with independent one-field contradictions, not merely an always-deny fixture remedy.
verification.limits: Offline Python/Git temporary fixtures only; no model CLI, network, wallet, compiler, proof, source edits or worker raw stdout/reasoning.

findings.title: Campaign ownership and current authority are unchecked
findings.evidence: Genuine campaign:sp01-loan-swap-grok-01 admits SP05 implementation with no missing evidence although its scope is RP01-MC02 specified design consistency only. Wrong stage/owner, null i2 campaignRecordId and complete-but-revoked also admit.
findings.fix: Resolve task gate stage/campaignOwner to its exact current campaign, scope/profile and authority/review bindings. Reject unrelated, historical-only, unsupported or conflicting admission. Do not grant source implementation from prerequisite acceptance.

findings.title: Binding-file digest substitutes for candidate and prerequisite currentness
findings.evidence: Changing/deleting candidate bytes still returns candidateCurrent=true. No candidateManifest, source map or acceptance/review is read. Null candidateHash/profile/campaign on a complete prerequisite and blocked atomic-prepare beneath atomic-accept still admit.
findings.fix: Verify actual supported manifest/source and acceptance/profile/review references, including prerequisite consistency. Missing candidate mapping is unresolved, including in the synthetic positive fixture. Keep current byte identity separate from stable failure lineage.

findings.title: Any resource JSON object becomes admitted resources
findings.evidence: Empty object, negative/zero/bool allocation, missing authority and unrelated scope all admit. Current charges, applicable successor amendments and action caps are unread.
findings.fix: Adapt real resource/allocation and explicit current budget/charge references; require matching authority/scope and sufficient valid remaining allowance. If current state cannot be resolved, name it as unavailable and deny only dependent work. Existing runner owns charging; do not add a second ledger.

findings.title: Unsupported and malformed file schemas admit or throw
findings.evidence: Unknown binding schema is named but ALLOWED; empty binding admits; list schema raises TypeError. Unknown catalog/nested-stage/command/history keys, version 999, conflicting duplicate action IDs, omitted gate requires, empty implementation commandRef and empty argv pass.
findings.fix: Validate exact supported versions and recursive closed shapes before deriving booleans. Reject duplicate identifiers and unsupported/missing required fields structurally. Require a nonempty registered actionful command. Return named unresolved evidence for wrong types, not exceptions; do not rely on incomplete string-prefix filters.

findings.title: Linked worktrees change the history lineage key
findings.evidence: In an actual temporary Git linked worktree, main repository history reports two failures and denies; linked repository identity differs, receives zero and allows. There is no Git common-dir lookup.
findings.fix: Use resolved git-common-dir for stable repository identity and selected worktree for source reads. Add a real linked-worktree regression. M2 still owns persistence and transactional recovery.

findings.title: Repair bypasses occupied primary implementation slot
findings.evidence: Both occupied-primary repair probes allow, including two failures with verified reproducer and changed approach. PRIMARY_BLOCKED_KINDS omits repair.
findings.fix: Include source repair in primary implementation policy. Preserve admitted reproducer/read-only paths. M2 must additionally reserve atomically.

findings.title: Fixed reads and resolved secret paths bypass containment
findings.evidence: A fixed program register symlink to an outside temporary file admits. A nonsecret resource path symlinked to an in-repository credentials.json is opened and admitted. All probe content was artificial JSON.
findings.fix: Apply contained reads to fixed program/sprint files as well as references. Check resolved path components for forbidden targets before opening. Keep the 8 MiB bound and duplicate-key rejection.

findings.title: Next-action selection is an unchecked history string
findings.evidence: Source inspection: nextActionId is None without history and otherwise only string-checked and copied. No catalogue existence, own admission, eligibility or reproducer/repair/review preference is evaluated. Tests inject a fixed ID.
findings.fix: Select an already admitted next action from normalized current records in the specified order; return named absence when none qualifies. This does not require building the M2 event store.

realRecordGuidance: Use the existing sprint entryGates stage/requires/campaignOwner, program stageAdmission stages and campaignRecordStore, then the selected campaigns record binding/bindingSha256, candidateManifest, review/acceptance, acceptedProfile, resourceAmendment and successor amendment references. Actual loan-swap candidate-04-freeze.json uses candidateSha256, digestAlgorithm, ownedFiles, inputs and baseCommit; its acceptance.json bridges sourceCandidate, candidateHash and publishedControlSha256 to unchanged payload hashes. Its review uses candidateSha256 and scope. Do not invent a universal candidateHash binding shape. Binding inputs/ownedFiles and authority are real references, not self-authenticating permission. Program resourceRuntimeSnapshot.path points to loan-swap-subset-01/current-runtime-budget.json and explicitly says historical reservations are not available credit. Resolve applicable current runner charges/caps and superseding amendments from explicit refs; a published snapshot alone cannot prove live remaining allowance. Current published RP01/atomic records do not prove a new SP05 implementation admission. Unavailable external live state must remain unavailable. No signed approval system or new design packet is needed.
m2Boundary: SQLite persistence, atomic reservation and launch revalidation, actual resource charging, runner-observed reproducer/review ingestion and interval accounting remain M2. Their absence alone is not the basis for rejection. Existing M1 policy/reader/lineage/selection defects must be fixed now.
disposition: One focused correction within approved M1 scope and limits, retain executable regressions, freeze exact new bytes and obtain required independent result review. No new design packet.
